rationale: The agent properly authenticated the user using full name and zip code, reviewed the user's orders, asked for confirmation before submitting a return, and successfully submitted the return for the correct items from the correct delivered order with accurate refund details. However, at the outset, the agent stated there were 12 t-shirt options "available right now," while the product data shows only 10 variants marked available (2 are unavailable). This is incorrect information unsupported by the tools. Because giving correct information is part of the pass bar, this error causes the overall outcome to fail despite the correct handling of the return process.
